source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל עַד־מָתַי֙ אַתָּה֙ מִתְאַבֵּ֣ל אֶל־שָׁא֔וּל וַאֲנִ֣י מְאַסְתִּ֔יו מִמְּלֹ֖ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מַלֵּ֨א קַרְנְךָ֜ שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֵ֤ךְ אֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֙ אֶל־יִשַׁ֣י בֵּֽית־הַלַּחְמִ֔י כִּֽי־רָאִ֧יתִי בְּבָנָ֛יו לִ֖י מֶֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Samuel, Until when [are] you mourning for Saul, and I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn [with] oil and go; I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have seen among his sons for myself a king.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "How long [are] you mourning for Saul, when I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn [with] oil and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have seen for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} a king among his sons."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "How long will you go on mourning for Saul, now that I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and set out. I am sending you to Jesse in Bethlehem, because I have chosen one of his sons to be king for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "How long will you keep on being sad about Saul? I have rejected him. He will not be king over Israel. Fill your horn with olive oil and go. I am sending you to Jesse, who lives in Bethlehem. I have chosen one of his sons to be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} king."

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Samuel: «¿Hasta cuándo [estarás] de duelo por Saúl, cuando yo lo he rechazado para que no reine sobre Israel? Llena tu cuerno [de] aceite y ve. Te enviaré a Isaí el belenita, porque he visto para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} un rey entre sus hijos».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «¿Hasta cuándo vas a seguir de duelo por Saúl, ahora que yo lo he rechazado para que no reine sobre Israel? Llena tu cuerno de aceite y ponte en camino. Te envío a Isaí, de Belén, porque he escogido a uno de sus hijos para que sea rey para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «¿Hasta cuándo vas a seguir triste por Saúl? Yo lo he rechazado. Él no seguirá siendo rey de Israel. Llena tu cuerno de aceite de oliva y ve. Te envío a Isaí, que vive en Belén. He escogido a uno de sus hijos para que sea {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rey».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Jusqu’à quand [seras]-tu en deuil de Saül, alors que je l’ai rejeté pour qu’il ne règne plus sur Israël ? Remplis ta corne d’huile et va. Je t’envoie chez Jessé le Bethléémite, car j’ai vu pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un roi parmi ses fils. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Combien de temps vas-tu encore pleurer Saül, maintenant que je l’ai rejeté et qu’il ne règnera plus sur Israël ? Remplis ta corne d’huile et mets-toi en route. Je t’envoie chez Jessé, à Bethléem, car je me suis choisi un roi parmi ses fils. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Samuel : « Combien de temps vas-tu encore être triste à cause de Saül ? Je l’ai rejeté. Il ne sera plus roi d’Israël. Remplis ta corne d’huile d’olive et pars. Je t’envoie chez Jessé, qui habite à Bethléem. J’ai choisi un de ses fils pour être {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} roi. »

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Hadi lini [utaendelea] kumwombolezea Sauli, nami nimemkataa asitawale juu ya Israeli? Jaza pembe yako mafuta, uende. Nitakutuma kwa Yese Mbethlehemu, kwa maana nimeona miongoni mwa wanawe mfalme kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Samweli, "Utaendelea kumwombolezea Sauli mpaka lini, hali mimi nimemkataa asiwe mfalme juu ya Israeli? Jaza pembe yako mafuta, uondoke. Ninakutuma kwa Yese wa Bethlehemu, kwa sababu nimemchagua mmoja wa wanawe awe mfalme kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Samweli, "Utaendelea kuhuzunika kwa ajili ya Sauli mpaka lini? Nimemkataa. Hatakuwa mfalme wa Israeli. Jaza pembe yako mafuta ya zeituni, uende. Ninakutuma kwa Yese, anayeishi Bethlehemu. Nimemchagua mmoja wa wanawe awe mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Ngươi còn khóc thương Sau-lơ cho đến bao giờ, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã loại bỏ nó, không cho làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên nữa? Hãy đổ đầy dầu vào sừng của ngươi và đi. Ta sai ngươi đến Gie-sê, người Bết-lê-hem, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thấy cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một vị vua trong số các con trai của người ấy."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Con còn than khóc Sau-lơ đến bao giờ nữa, trong khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã loại bỏ nó, không cho nó làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên? Hãy đổ đầy dầu vào sừng của con và lên đường. Ta sai con đến nhà Gie-sê ở Bết-lê-hem, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn một trong các con trai của ông ấy làm vua cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Con còn buồn rầu về Sau-lơ đến bao giờ? Ta đã loại bỏ nó. Nó sẽ không làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên nữa. Hãy đổ đầy dầu ô-liu vào sừng của con rồi đi. Ta sai con đến gặp Gie-sê, người sống ở Bết-lê-hem. Ta đã chọn một người con trai của ông ấy làm vua của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 그를 이스라엘을 다스리는 왕의 자리에서 버렸는데, 너는 언제까지 사울을 위해 슬퍼하고 있겠느냐? 네 뿔에 기름을 채우고 가거라. 내가 너를 베들레헴 사람 이새에게 보내겠다. 내가 그의 아들들 가운데에서 나를 위하여 한 왕을 보아 두었다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 이미 사울을 버려 이스라엘의 왕이 되지 못하게 하였는데, 너는 언제까지 그를 두고 슬퍼하겠느냐? 뿔에 기름을 채워 길을 떠나라. 내가 너를 베들레헴에 사는 이새에게 보낸다. 내가 그의 아들 가운데 하나를 골라 나의 왕으로 삼았다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "언제까지 사울 때문에 슬퍼하고 있겠느냐? 나는 사울을 버렸다. 그는 더 이상 이스라엘의 왕이 아니다. 뿔에 올리브기름을 가득 채우고 떠나라. 내가 너를 베들레헴에 사는 이새에게 보낸다. 내가 이새의 아들 가운데 하나를 나의 왕으로 골랐다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Até quando tu [estarás] de luto por Saul, quando eu o rejeitei para que não reine sobre Israel? Enche de azeite o teu chifre e vai. Eu te enviarei a Jessé, o belemita, pois vi para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} um rei entre os seus filhos."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Até quando vais continuar de luto por Saul, se eu o rejeitei como rei de Israel? Enche de azeite o teu chifre e põe-te a caminho. Eu te envio a Jessé, em Belém, porque escolhi um dos filhos dele para ser rei para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Até quando vais ficar triste por causa de Saul? Eu o rejeitei. Ele não vai ser rei de Israel. Enche o teu chifre de azeite de oliva e vai. Eu te envio a Jessé, que mora em Belém. Escolhi um dos filhos dele para ser o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rei."

decisions.choice: mourning for Saul whom the LORD has rejected
decisions.reason: The chapter follows straight on from 15:35, where Samuel mourned for Saul and Yahweh regretted making him king. The verb "rejected" is the word of 15:23 and 15:26: Saul rejected Yahweh's word, so Yahweh rejected him as king. Samuel's grief is real, but the time for it is over.

decisions.choice: fill your horn with oil: prepare to anoint a king
decisions.reason: Oil was carried in an animal's horn. Pouring oil on someone's head set that person apart for an office; Samuel had anointed Saul with oil from a flask (10:1). The command already tells Samuel what the journey is for.

decisions.choice: I have seen for myself a king: I have chosen and provided a king
alternatives: I have provided for myself a king
decisions.reason: "See" here means to look out and select, as in Genesis 22:8, 14, where God "sees" (provides) the lamb. "For myself" stands against the story of Saul, the king the people asked for (8:5; 12:13). This king is Yahweh's own choice.

decisions.choice: Jesse the Bethlehemite: Jesse from Bethlehem in Judah
decisions.reason: Bethlehem lay a few miles south of Jerusalem, in the hill country of Judah. Jesse was the grandson of Boaz and Ruth (Ruth 4:17-22).

decisions.choice: chosen
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "chosen" for "seen" in this sense of picking out (m3); Literal keeps "seen".

decisions.choice: olive oil
decisions.reason: Readable names the kind of oil used for anointing (Exodus 30:24) and splits the rejection into short sentences.

decisions.choice: passé simple for narration at Literal and Balanced ("dit"); passé composé at Readable ("a dit"); speech in the tenses of speech
decisions.reason: For this block of 1 Samuel (16-31), as the French style guide and the Pentateuch note set: the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative, the passé composé the plain tense of Readable.

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR" (default), "Yahvé" (alternative) for the divine name
decisions.reason: For this block, as the Pentateuch and Samuel terms notes set: the divine name is "le SEIGNEUR" in capitals, with the article inside the span; "l'Éternel", the Segond tradition, is the form a reviewer may prefer.

decisions.choice: preterite for narration (“dijo”, “fue”); tú for one person, the king included; «» for speech
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note and the Pentateuch note set for Spanish: narrative in the preterite at every level; one person is addressed as tú, respect carried by “mi señor el rey” and “tu siervo”; plural address is a plural_you span. Recorded once for this block of chapters (16-31).

decisions.choice: he escogido
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced and Readable “chosen” (r-en-1): “I have seen for myself” means God has chosen and provided a king (m3). Literal keeps “he visto”.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} for YHWH; deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns
decisions.reason: For this block of 1 Samuel (16-31), as in the Pentateuch and Psalms: the divine name is "BWANA" in capitals, with the name "Yahwe" as the reader-setting alternative. Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb, where a capital cannot go, so deity_pronoun spans stand only on free pronouns and possessives ("kwa ajili yangu", "mfalme wangu").

decisions.choice: "Mbethlehemu" (L); "wa Bethlehemu" (B), "anayeishi Bethlehemu" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gentilic "the Bethlehemite" is formed in Swahili with the person prefix m- on the town's name (Bethlehemu), as "Mwedomu", "Mhiti". Balanced and Readable say where Jesse lived, as the English does.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" (spanned mid-sentence) and calls Samuel "ngươi" (L), "con" (B, R); he speaks of Saul as "nó"
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note sets for God speaking to a person. "nó" for the king God has rejected follows God's plain third person to his prophet; a reviewer may prefer "người ấy".

decisions.choice: "đã thấy cho chính Ta" (L); "đã chọn" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb "see"; the meaning decision (m3) reads it as choosing and providing, which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: God speaks to Samuel in the plain style (해라체) with "나" and "너"; the narrative gives God the honorific (말씀하셨다)
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for the whole Old Testament. Korean has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans ("myself/Myself") have nothing to change in Korean; respect for God is carried by the honorific -시- and 께서 at every level.

decisions.choice: "보아 두었다" (have seen [for myself]) at Literal; "골라 ... 삼았다" / "골랐다" (chose) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb "see" in the sense of looking out and providing (meaning decision m3); Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: tu (the LORD to Samuel)
decisions.reason: For these chapters, as for the whole book: the LORD speaks to Samuel, Saul and David with "tu" ("Enche o teu chifre", "Eu te envio"), as God addresses one person throughout the Portuguese Old Testament; people speak to each other with "você", and to the king with "o senhor".

decisions.choice: vi para mim um rei
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "vi", the verb of seeing that the note links to Genesis 22:8, 14 (m3); Balanced and Readable say "escolhi", as the English does.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֵ֣יךְ אֵלֵ֔ךְ וְשָׁמַ֥ע שָׁא֖וּל וַהֲרָגָ֑נִיסוַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה עֶגְלַ֤ת בָּקָר֙ תִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ לִזְבֹּ֥חַ לַֽיהוָ֖ה בָּֽאתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel, How will I go? And will hear Saul and he will kill me. And said Yahweh, A heifer of [the] herd you will take in your hand, and you will say, To sacrifice to Yahweh I have come.

en.B: Samuel said, "How can I go? Saul will hear of it and kill me." {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Take a young cow with you and say, 'I have come to offer a sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'
en.R: Samuel said, "How can I go? If Saul hears about it, he will kill me." {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Take a young cow with you. Say, 'I have come to offer a sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'

es.L: Y dijo Samuel: «¿Cómo iré? Si Saúl [lo] oye, me matará». Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: «Toma en tu mano una becerra de la vacada, y di: “He venido a ofrecer sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}”.

es.R: Samuel dijo: «¿Cómo voy a ir? Si Saúl se entera, me matará». {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Lleva contigo una ternera. Di: “He venido a ofrecer un sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}”.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit : « Comment irai-je ? Saül l’apprendra et il me tuera. » Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « Tu prendras dans ta main une génisse du troupeau, et tu diras : “Je suis venu sacrifier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.”
fr.B: Samuel répondit : « Comment pourrais-je y aller ? Saül l’apprendra et il me tuera. » {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : « Emmène avec toi une jeune vache et dis : “Je suis venu offrir un sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.”
fr.R: Samuel a répondu : « Comment est-ce que je peux y aller ? Si Saül l’apprend, il va me tuer. » {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a dit : « Emmène une jeune vache avec toi. Dis : “Je suis venu offrir un sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.”

sw.R: Samweli akasema, "Nitawezaje kwenda? Sauli akisikia habari hii, ataniua." {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Chukua ng'ombe jike mchanga pamoja nawe. Useme, 'Nimekuja kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu.'

vi.B: Sa-mu-ên thưa: "Làm sao con đi được? Sau-lơ sẽ nghe biết và giết con." {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Hãy đem theo một con bò cái tơ và nói: 'Tôi đến để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.'
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên thưa: "Làm sao con đi được? Nếu Sau-lơ nghe biết, ông ấy sẽ giết con." {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Hãy đem theo một con bò cái tơ. Con hãy nói: 'Tôi đến để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.'

ko.L: 그러자 사무엘이 말했다. "제가 어떻게 가겠습니까? 사울이 들으면 저를 죽일 것입니다." 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "너는 소 떼 가운데에서 암송아지 한 마리를 네 손에 끌고 가서 '내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리러 왔다' 하고 말하여라.
ko.B: 사무엘이 말했다. "제가 어떻게 가겠습니까? 사울이 그 소식을 들으면 저를 죽일 것입니다." {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "어린 암소 한 마리를 끌고 가서 '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리러 왔다' 하고 말하여라.
