decisions.choice: Samuel fears for his life
decisions.reason: To anoint another king while Saul still reigned was treason in Saul's eyes. Saul had already shown that he could turn on those close to him (14:44), and Samuel had just announced that his kingdom was torn from him (15:28).

decisions.choice: say, I have come to sacrifice: a true reason given, the full purpose kept hidden
decisions.reason: The sacrifice is real; Samuel holds it (verse 5). Yahweh does not tell him to say anything false, but he does not have to tell everyone why he has come. The hidden purpose protects Samuel and David from Saul.

decisions.choice: in your hand: with you
decisions.reason: "Take in your hand" means to take along with you; a heifer is led, not carried.

decisions.choice: a young cow
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "young cow" for a heifer, a cow that has not yet borne a calf; Literal keeps "heifer of the herd".

decisions.choice: the quotation stays open
decisions.reason: Yahweh's words go on into verse 3, so the quotation mark closes there.

decisions.choice: une jeune vache (B, R); une génisse (L)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): "génisse" is the exact word but less known to young readers; Balanced and Readable say what it is.

decisions.choice: una ternera
decisions.reason: A young cow, as the English “a young cow” (r-en-1); Literal keeps “una becerra de la vacada”, the Hebrew “heifer of the herd”.

decisions.choice: "mtamba" (L); "ng'ombe jike mchanga" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Mtamba" is the Swahili word for a heifer, a young cow that has not calved; Balanced and Readable describe it in everyday words, as the English "young cow" does. "Ndama" is a calf, too young for this sacrifice.

decisions.choice: Samuel speaks to God with "thưa" and calls himself "con" (B, R); Literal keeps the bare "nói" and "tôi"
decisions.reason: People speak to God in prayer forms (Genesis terms note); Literal stays with the Hebrew's plain "said".

decisions.choice: Samuel speaks to God in the formal polite style (합쇼체) with "저"
decisions.reason: People speak to God in 합쇼체 with 저/제, as the terms of this translation set for prayer and for speech to God.

decisions.choice: uma novilha
decisions.reason: "Novilha" is the ordinary Portuguese word for a young cow that has not calved, so Balanced and Readable need no paraphrase where the English says "young cow"; Literal adds "do gado" for "of the herd".

source.text: וְקָרָ֥אתָ לְיִשַׁ֖י בַּזָּ֑בַח וְאָֽנֹכִ֗י אוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶֽׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ לִ֔י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַ֖ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will make known to you what you will do, and you will anoint for me [the one] whom I say to you.

en.L: And you shall invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will make known to you what you shall do, and you shall anoint for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} [the one] whom I say to you."
en.B: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what to do. You will anoint for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} the one I name to you."
en.R: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice. Then I will show you what to do. You will pour oil on the one I point out to you. That will show that I have chosen him."

es.L: E invitarás a Isaí al sacrificio, y yo te haré saber lo que harás, y me ungirás [al] que yo te diga».
es.B: Invita a Isaí al sacrificio, y yo te mostraré lo que tienes que hacer. Ungirás para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} al que yo te señale».
es.R: Invita a Isaí al sacrificio. Luego yo te mostraré lo que debes hacer. Derramarás aceite sobre aquel que yo te señale. Eso mostrará que yo lo he escogido».

fr.L: Et tu inviteras Jessé au sacrifice, et moi, je te ferai connaître ce que tu feras, et tu oindras pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} [celui] que je te dirai. »
fr.B: Invite Jessé au sacrifice, et je te montrerai ce que tu dois faire. Tu oindras pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} celui que je te désignerai. »
fr.R: Invite Jessé au sacrifice. Ensuite, je te montrerai ce que tu dois faire. Tu verseras de l’huile sur la tête de celui que je t’indiquerai. Cela montrera que je l’ai choisi. »

sw.L: Nawe utamwalika Yese kwenye dhabihu, nami nitakujulisha utakalofanya, nawe utampaka mafuta kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} [yule] nitakayekuambia."
sw.B: Mwalike Yese kwenye dhabihu, nami nitakuonyesha la kufanya. Utampaka mafuta kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yule nitakayekutajia."
sw.R: Mwalike Yese aje kwenye dhabihu. Kisha nitakuonyesha la kufanya. Utammiminia mafuta kichwani yule nitakayekuonyesha. Hiyo itaonyesha kwamba nimemchagua."

vi.L: Ngươi hãy mời Gie-sê đến dự tế lễ, rồi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho ngươi biết điều ngươi phải làm, và ngươi sẽ xức dầu cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [người] mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chỉ cho ngươi."
vi.B: Hãy mời Gie-sê đến dự lễ, rồi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chỉ cho con điều phải làm. Con sẽ xức dầu cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} người mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chỉ định cho con."
vi.R: Hãy mời Gie-sê đến dự lễ. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chỉ cho con điều phải làm. Con sẽ đổ dầu trên người mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chỉ cho con. Việc đó sẽ cho thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn người ấy."

ko.L: 그리고 너는 이새를 그 제사에 초대하여라. 네가 무엇을 해야 할지 내가 너에게 알려 주겠다. 너는 내가 너에게 말하는 [그 사람]에게 나를 위하여 기름을 부어라."
ko.B: 이새를 제사에 초대하여라. 그러면 네가 할 일을 내가 알려 주겠다. 너는 내가 일러 주는 사람에게 기름을 부어 나의 왕으로 세워라."
ko.R: 이새를 제사에 초대하여라. 그다음에 네가 할 일을 내가 보여 주겠다. 너는 내가 가리키는 사람의 머리에 기름을 부어라. 그것은 내가 그를 왕으로 골랐다는 표시가 될 것이다."

pt.L: E convidarás Jessé para o sacrifício, e eu te farei saber o que farás, e ungirás para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} [aquele] que eu te disser."
pt.B: Convida Jessé para o sacrifício, e eu te mostrarei o que fazer. Tu ungirás para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} aquele que eu te indicar."
pt.R: Convida Jessé para o sacrifício. Depois eu te mostrarei o que fazer. Tu vais derramar azeite sobre aquele que eu te apontar. Assim ficará claro que eu o escolhi."

decisions.choice: I will make known: Yahweh keeps the choice in his own hands
decisions.reason: Samuel is not told the name in advance. He must wait for Yahweh to show him, step by step, which son to anoint (verses 6-12).

decisions.choice: anoint for me: anoint as my king
decisions.reason: "For me" picks up "for myself" in verse 1. The one Samuel anoints will be Yahweh's king.

decisions.choice: pour oil on ... That will show that I have chosen him
decisions.reason: Readable explains what anointing is and what it meant here (verse 1, m2; verse 13).

decisions.choice: "kumpaka mafuta" for anoint
decisions.reason: The book's word for anointing a king is "kumpaka mafuta" (terms note); "for me" is "kwa ajili yangu", a free pronoun that takes the deity pronoun span. Readable says what anointing was, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "xức dầu" (L, B); "đổ dầu trên" (R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note sets "xức dầu" for anointing a king; Readable says what is done and adds what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֣ית לָ֑חֶם וַיֶּחֶרְד֞וּ זִקְנֵ֤י הָעִיר֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֹ֥ם בּוֹאֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And did Samuel what spoke Yahweh, and he came [to] Bethlehem; and trembled [the] elders of the city to meet him, and he said, [Is it] peace, your coming?

en.L: And Samuel did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the city came trembling to meet him, and said, "Is your coming peace?"
en.B: Samuel did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said and went to Bethlehem. The elders of the town came out trembling to meet him and asked, "Have you come in peace?"
en.R: Samuel did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told him and went to Bethlehem. The leaders of the town were afraid when they came to meet him. They asked, "Have you come as a friend?"

es.L: E hizo Samuel lo que había dicho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y llegó a Belén. Y los ancianos de la ciudad salieron temblando a su encuentro, y dijo: «¿Es de paz tu venida?».
es.B: Samuel hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dicho y fue a Belén. Los ancianos de la ciudad salieron temblando a recibirlo y le preguntaron: «¿Vienes en paz?».
es.R: Samuel hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le mandó y fue a Belén. Los líderes del pueblo tenían miedo cuando salieron a recibirlo. Le preguntaron: «¿Vienes como amigo?».

fr.L: Et Samuel fit ce qu’avait dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et il vint à Bethléem. Et les anciens de la ville vinrent en tremblant à sa rencontre, et il dit : « Ta venue [est-elle] la paix ? »
fr.B: Samuel fit ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit et se rendit à Bethléem. Les anciens de la ville vinrent tout tremblants à sa rencontre et lui demandèrent : « Viens-tu en paix ? »
fr.R: Samuel a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait dit et il est allé à Bethléem. Les responsables de la ville avaient peur quand ils sont venus à sa rencontre. Ils lui ont demandé : « Est-ce que tu viens en ami ? »

sw.L: Samweli akafanya kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema, akafika Bethlehemu. Wazee wa mji wakaja kumlaki wakitetemeka, akasema, "Je, kuja kwako ni kwa amani?"
sw.B: Samweli akafanya kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema, akaenda Bethlehemu. Wazee wa mji wakatoka kumlaki wakitetemeka, wakamwuliza, "Je, umekuja kwa amani?"
sw.R: Samweli akafanya kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwambia, akaenda Bethlehemu. Viongozi wa mji walipokuja kumlaki, waliogopa. Wakamwuliza, "Je, umekuja kama rafiki?"

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán và đến Bết-lê-hem. Các trưởng lão của thành run sợ ra đón ông và nói: "Ông đến có bình an không?"
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên làm theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đi đến Bết-lê-hem. Các trưởng lão trong thành run rẩy ra đón ông và hỏi: "Ông đến có bình an không?"
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên làm theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dặn và đi đến Bết-lê-hem. Những người lãnh đạo trong thành sợ hãi khi ra đón ông. Họ hỏi: "Ông đến đây với thiện ý phải không?"

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 행하여 베들레헴으로 갔다. 그러자 그 성의 장로들이 떨면서 그를 맞으러 나와 말했다. "당신이 오신 것이 평안입니까?"
ko.B: 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 베들레헴으로 갔다. 그 성읍의 장로들이 떨면서 그를 맞으러 나와 물었다. "평안한 일로 오십니까?"
ko.R: 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 베들레헴으로 갔다. 그 마을의 지도자들은 그를 맞으러 나오면서 두려워 떨었다. 그들이 물었다. "좋은 일로 오셨습니까?"

pt.L: E Samuel fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha falado, e veio a Belém. E os anciãos da cidade vieram tremendo ao seu encontro e disseram: "[É de] paz a vinda do senhor?"
pt.B: Samuel fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito e foi a Belém. Os anciãos da cidade saíram tremendo ao seu encontro e perguntaram: "O senhor vem em paz?"
pt.R: Samuel fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe disse e foi a Belém. Os líderes da cidade ficaram com medo quando foram encontrá-lo. Eles perguntaram: "O senhor veio como amigo?"

decisions.choice: the elders trembled: a visit from the prophet could mean judgment
decisions.reason: Samuel went around Israel as judge (7:15-17), and he had just put Agag to death (15:33). A sudden visit from him could mean that the town had done wrong or that trouble was coming. The elders were the town's leading men, the heads of its families.

decisions.choice: is your coming peace: do you come with good intent
decisions.reason: Shalom here means well-being and friendship, the opposite of trouble. The same question is asked when a visitor's purpose is unknown (1 Kings 2:13; 2 Kings 9:17-22).

decisions.choice: and he said: one spoke for the elders
decisions.reason: The verb is singular. Either one elder spoke for all, or the writer treats the elders as one group.

decisions.choice: leaders
decisions.reason: Readable says "leaders" for the elders, since the point is their position in the town, not their age.

decisions.choice: as a friend
decisions.reason: Readable puts "in peace" in plain words (m2).

decisions.choice: "Viens-tu en paix ?"
decisions.reason: The question as the Samuel terms note sets it for the book; Literal keeps the Hebrew's noun phrase ("Ta venue [est-elle] la paix ?") and the singular verb (m3).

decisions.choice: les responsables de la ville
decisions.reason: Readable names the elders by their position, as the English "leaders" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: «¿Es de paz tu venida?» (L); «¿Vienes en paz?» (B)
decisions.reason: The question asks whether Samuel comes with good intent (m2); Balanced uses the wording the Samuel terms note sets for this greeting. Readable says “como amigo”, as the English “as a friend”.

decisions.choice: "akasema" (singular) at Literal; "wakamwuliza" (plural) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is singular (m3); Literal keeps it, while Balanced and Readable let the elders ask together, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Ông đến có bình an không?" (L, B); "Ông đến đây với thiện ý phải không?" (R)
alternatives: "Ông đến với tư cách bạn hữu phải không?"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form of the question; Readable says plainly what "peace" asks (m2), as the English "as a friend".

decisions.choice: the elders speak to Samuel in the formal polite style (합쇼체); Samuel answers them, and speaks to Jesse's family, in the plain style (해라체)
decisions.reason: Samuel is the aged prophet and judge of all Israel, and the elders come trembling; the plain style for him and the honorific for them shows the standing the Hebrew scene gives each. "평안한 일로 오십니까?" is the form this translation sets for the question about *shalom* to a superior.

decisions.choice: o senhor (the elders to Samuel)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the people speak to Samuel the prophet with "o senhor", the respectful address to a superior, and Samuel answers them with "vocês" (verse 5).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀שָׁל֗וֹם לִזְבֹּ֤חַ לַֽיהוָה֙ בָּ֔אתִי הִֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וּבָאתֶ֥ם אִתִּ֖י בַּזָּ֑בַח וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶת־יִשַׁי֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֔יו וַיִּקְרָ֥א לָהֶ֖ם לַזָּֽבַח׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Peace; to sacrifice to Yahweh I have come. Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice. And he consecrated Jesse and his sons, and he invited them to the sacrifice.

en.L: And he said, "Peace. I have come to sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice." And he consecrated Jesse and his sons, and invited them to the sacrifice.
en.B: He said, "In peace. I have come to offer a sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Make yourselves holy and come with me to the sacrifice." He made Jesse and his sons holy and invited them to the sacrifice.
en.R: Samuel answered, "Yes, I come in peace. I have come to offer a sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Get yourselves ready and make yourselves clean, and then come with me to the sacrifice." Samuel also helped Jesse and his sons to get ready, and he invited them to the sacrifice.

es.L: Y dijo: «Paz. He venido a ofrecer sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Santifíquense y vengan|Santificaos y venid}} conmigo al sacrificio». Y santificó a Isaí y a sus hijos, y los invitó al sacrificio.
es.B: Él respondió: «En paz. He venido a ofrecer un sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Purifíquense y vengan|Purificaos y venid}} conmigo al sacrificio». Purificó a Isaí y a sus hijos, y los invitó al sacrificio.
es.R: Samuel contestó: «Sí, vengo en paz. He venido a ofrecer un sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Prepárense y purifíquense, y luego vengan|Preparaos y purificaos, y luego venid}} conmigo al sacrificio». Samuel también ayudó a Isaí y a sus hijos a prepararse, y los invitó al sacrificio.

fr.L: Et il dit : « La paix. Je suis venu sacrifier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Sanctifiez-vous et venez avec moi au sacrifice. » Et il sanctifia Jessé et ses fils, et il les invita au sacrifice.
fr.B: Il répondit : « Oui, en paix. Je suis venu offrir un sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Purifiez-vous et venez avec moi au sacrifice. » Il purifia Jessé et ses fils et les invita au sacrifice.
fr.R: Samuel a répondu : « Oui, je viens en paix. Je suis venu offrir un sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Préparez-vous et rendez-vous purs, puis venez avec moi au sacrifice. » Samuel a aussi aidé Jessé et ses fils à se préparer, et il les a invités au sacrifice.

sw.L: Akasema, "Amani. Nimekuja kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu. Jitakaseni, mje pamoja nami kwenye dhabihu." Akamtakasa Yese na wanawe, akawaalika kwenye dhabihu.
sw.B: Akasema, "Kwa amani. Nimekuja kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu. Jitakaseni, mje pamoja nami kwenye dhabihu." Akamtakasa Yese na wanawe, akawaalika kwenye dhabihu.
sw.R: Samweli akajibu, "Ndiyo, nimekuja kwa amani. Nimekuja kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu. Jiandaeni na kujisafisha, kisha mje pamoja nami kwenye dhabihu." Samweli akamsaidia Yese na wanawe kujiandaa, akawaalika kwenye dhabihu.

vi.L: Ông nói: "Bình an. Tôi đến để dâng tế lễ cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Các ông hãy thánh hóa mình rồi đến dự tế lễ với tôi." Ông thánh hóa Gie-sê và các con trai ông ấy, rồi mời họ đến dự tế lễ.
vi.B: Ông đáp: "Bình an. Tôi đến để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Các ông hãy làm cho mình nên thánh rồi đến dự lễ với tôi." Ông làm cho Gie-sê và các con trai ông ấy nên thánh, rồi mời họ đến dự lễ.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên đáp: "Vâng, tôi đến trong bình an. Tôi đến để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Các ông hãy chuẩn bị và tẩy sạch mình, rồi đến dự lễ với tôi." Sa-mu-ên cũng giúp Gie-sê và các con trai ông ấy chuẩn bị, rồi mời họ đến dự lễ.

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "평안이다. 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리러 왔다. 너희는 몸을 거룩하게 하고 나와 함께 제사에 가자." 그리고 그가 이새와 그의 아들들을 거룩하게 하고 그들을 제사에 초대했다.
ko.B: 사무엘이 대답했다. "평안한 일이다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리러 왔다. 너희는 몸을 거룩하게 하고 나와 함께 제사에 가자." 사무엘은 이새와 그의 아들들을 거룩하게 하고, 그들을 제사에 초대했다.
ko.R: 사무엘이 대답했다. "그렇다. 좋은 일로 왔다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리러 왔다. 너희는 몸을 씻고 깨끗하게 준비한 다음 나와 함께 제사에 가자." 사무엘은 이새와 그의 아들들도 준비하도록 도와주고, 그들을 제사에 초대했다.

pt.L: E ele disse: "Paz. Vim sacrificar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Consagrem-se e venham comigo ao sacrifício." E ele consagrou Jessé e os seus filhos e os convidou para o sacrifício.
pt.B: Ele respondeu: "Em paz. Vim oferecer um sacrifício {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Santifiquem-se e venham comigo ao sacrifício." Ele santificou Jessé e os seus filhos e os convidou para o sacrifício.
pt.R: Samuel respondeu: "Sim, venho em paz. Vim oferecer um sacrifício {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Preparem-se e purifiquem-se, e depois venham comigo ao sacrifício." Samuel também ajudou Jessé e os seus filhos a se prepararem, e os convidou para o sacrifício.

decisions.choice: consecrate: make ready to come near to God
decisions.reason: Before a sacrifice or a meeting with God, people made themselves holy by washing, putting on clean clothes and keeping away from what made them unclean (Exodus 19:10-15; Joshua 3:5). Samuel himself oversees this for Jesse's family.

decisions.choice: the sacrifice: an offering followed by a shared meal
decisions.reason: Part of such a sacrifice was eaten by the guests at a feast, as at Samuel's sacrifice in 9:12-13, 22-24. Verse 11 speaks of not sitting down until David comes.

decisions.choice: make yourselves holy
decisions.reason: Balanced says "make holy" for "consecrate", the plainer word for setting someone apart for God.

decisions.choice: get yourselves ready and make yourselves clean
decisions.reason: Readable describes what consecrating oneself meant (m1).

decisions.choice: sanctifiez-vous (L); purifiez-vous (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the root sense of making holy; Balanced says "purifier", the everyday French for the washing and preparation meant here (m1), as the English Balanced plainer "make holy".

decisions.choice: purificarse
decisions.reason: To consecrate oneself here is to make oneself ritually ready to come near to God (m1). Literal keeps “santificar”; Balanced and Readable use “purificarse”, the plain Spanish word for that preparation, where the English Balanced says “make yourselves holy”.

decisions.choice: "jitakaseni", "akamtakasa"
decisions.reason: "Kujitakasa" is the usual Swahili word for making oneself holy before meeting God, and it covers both the Hebrew "consecrate" and the Balanced English "make holy". Readable describes what was done (m1).

decisions.choice: "thánh hóa" (L); "làm cho mình nên thánh" (B); "chuẩn bị và tẩy sạch mình" (R)
decisions.reason: Consecration made people ready to come near to God (m1); Readable says what was done, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "몸을 씻고 깨끗하게 준비한" (wash and get clean and ready) at Readable for "consecrate yourselves"
decisions.reason: Readable says what consecrating oneself involved, as the English Readable does (meaning decision m1); Literal and Balanced keep "거룩하게 하다".

decisions.choice: Santifiquem-se; santificou
decisions.reason: Where the English Balanced says "make holy", Portuguese has the single verb "santificar-se", which says the same plainly; Literal keeps "consagrar".

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֔ם וַיַּ֖רְא אֶת־אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַ֛ךְ נֶ֥גֶד יְהוָ֖ה מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, in their coming, and he saw Eliab, and he said, Surely before Yahweh [is] his anointed.

en.L: And it happened when they came, he saw Eliab and said, "Surely before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed."
en.B: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and thought, "Surely here before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stands {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed!"
en.R: When they came, Samuel saw Eliab, Jesse's oldest son. He thought, "This must be the man {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has chosen to be king. Here he is, standing in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Y sucedió que cuando ellos llegaron, vio a Eliab y dijo: «Ciertamente delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido».
es.B: Cuando llegaron, Samuel vio a Eliab y pensó: «¡Seguro que aquí, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, está {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido!».
es.R: Cuando llegaron, Samuel vio a Eliab, el hijo mayor de Isaí. Pensó: «Este tiene que ser el hombre que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha escogido para ser rey. Aquí está, de pie delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand ils vinrent, qu’il vit Éliab et dit : « Sûrement, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint. »
fr.B: Quand ils arrivèrent, Samuel vit Éliab et se dit : « C’est sûrement lui, l’oint {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui se tient ici devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ! »
fr.R: Quand ils sont arrivés, Samuel a vu Éliab, le fils aîné de Jessé. Il a pensé : « Voilà sûrement l’homme que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a choisi pour être roi. Il est là, devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »

sw.L: Ikawa walipokuja, akamwona Eliabu, akasema, "Hakika masihi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [yuko] mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Walipofika, Samweli akamwona Eliabu, akawaza, "Hakika mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} aliyempaka mafuta amesimama hapa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!"
sw.R: Walipofika, Samweli akamwona Eliabu, mwana mkubwa wa Yese. Akawaza, "Bila shaka huyu ndiye mtu ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemchagua kuwa mfalme. Huyu hapa, amesimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."

vi.L: Khi họ đến, ông thấy Ê-li-áp và nói: "Chắc chắn người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [đang ở] trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Khi họ đến, Sa-mu-ên thấy Ê-li-áp và nghĩ: "Chắc chắn người được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} xức dầu đang đứng đây trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"
vi.R: Khi họ đến, Sa-mu-ên thấy Ê-li-áp, con trai cả của Gie-sê. Ông nghĩ: "Hẳn đây là người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn làm vua. Người ấy đang đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 왔을 때, 그가 엘리압을 보고 말했다. "정녕 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 그분의 기름 부음 받은 이가 [있다]."
ko.B: 그들이 도착했을 때, 사무엘은 엘리압을 보고 생각했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기름 부으실 사람이 틀림없이 지금 주님 앞에 서 있구나!"
ko.R: 그들이 왔을 때, 사무엘은 이새의 맏아들 엘리압을 보았다. 사무엘은 속으로 생각했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕으로 고르신 사람이 바로 이 사람이구나. 여기 주님 앞에 서 있구나."

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando eles chegaram, ele viu Eliabe e disse: "Certamente diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [está] o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} ungido."
pt.B: Quando eles chegaram, Samuel viu Eliabe e pensou: "Com certeza está aqui, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} ungido!"
pt.R: Quando eles chegaram, Samuel viu Eliabe, o filho mais velho de Jessé. Ele pensou: "Este deve ser o homem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} escolheu para ser rei. Aqui está ele, em pé diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}."

decisions.choice: he said: he said to himself
decisions.reason: "Said" often means said in one's own mind (Genesis 17:17; 1 Samuel 18:17). Yahweh's answer in verse 7 replies to what Samuel thought.

decisions.choice: his anointed: the king Yahweh has chosen
decisions.reason: "Anointed" is the title of the king set apart by Yahweh (2:10; 12:3; 24:7). Samuel takes Eliab to be the one he has come to anoint.

decisions.choice: Eliab: Jesse's firstborn, tall like Saul
decisions.reason: Eliab was Jesse's oldest son (17:13). Verse 7 shows that Samuel was struck by his height, just as the people had been struck by Saul, a head taller than everyone (9:2; 10:23-24).

decisions.choice: thought
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "thought" so that readers do not take it that Samuel spoke aloud (m1).

decisions.choice: Jesse's oldest son ... the man the LORD has chosen to be king
decisions.reason: Readable adds who Eliab was (17:13) and explains "his anointed" (m2), as the book's terms do for "the LORD's anointed".

decisions.choice: se dit (B); a pensé (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): Samuel speaks in his own mind (m1), so Balanced and Readable say so; Literal keeps "dit".

decisions.choice: "masihi wake" (L); "mfalme wake aliyempaka mafuta" (B)
decisions.reason: "His anointed" (m2) is the title of the king. As the terms note does for "the LORD's anointed", Literal says "masihi" and Balanced says who he is, "the king he has anointed". The possessive "wake" is a free word, so it takes the deity pronoun span as the English "his" does.

decisions.choice: "người được xức dầu của Ngài" (L); "người được CHÚA xức dầu" (B)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for the anointed; Balanced moves the divine name into the phrase and puts the pronoun after "trước mặt", which reads more naturally.

decisions.choice: "생각했다" (thought) for "said" at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps "말했다"
decisions.reason: Samuel speaks in his own mind (meaning decision m1); Korean "생각했다" keeps readers from taking it that he spoke aloud, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Eliabe; Jessé; Abinadabe (verse 8); Samá (verse 9)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the brothers' names take the usual Brazilian forms, with the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant, as "Calebe" and "Joabe"; "Jessé" as in Ruth 4:17-22.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אַל־תַּבֵּ֧ט אֶל־מַרְאֵ֛הוּ וְאֶל־גְּבֹ֥הַּ קוֹמָת֖וֹ כִּ֣י מְאַסְתִּ֑יהוּ כִּ֣י׀לֹ֗א אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִרְאֶה֙ הָאָדָ֔ם כִּ֤י הָֽאָדָם֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה לַעֵינַ֔יִם וַיהוָ֖ה יִרְאֶ֥ה לַלֵּבָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Samuel, Do not look to his appearance and to [the] height of his stature, for I have rejected him; for not what sees the man; for the man sees to the eyes, and Yahweh sees to the heart.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Do not look at his appearance or at the height of his stature, for I have rejected him. For [it is] not what {{gender:a human being|man}} sees, for {{gender:a human being|man}} sees to the eyes, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sees to the heart."
en.B: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Pay no attention to his looks or to how tall he is, because I have rejected him. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} does not see in the way {{gender:a person|man}} sees. {{gender:A person|Man}} looks at what is there for the eyes, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looks at the heart."
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Do not think about how fine he looks or how tall he is. I have not chosen him. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} does not see things the way people do. People see what is on the outside, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sees what is inside a person."

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Samuel: «No mires su apariencia ni lo alto de su estatura, porque yo lo he rechazado. Porque [no es] lo que ve {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}}; porque {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}} mira a los ojos, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mira al corazón».
es.B: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «No te fijes en su aspecto ni en lo alto que es, porque yo lo he rechazado. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ve como ve {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}}. {{gender:El ser humano|El hombre}} mira lo que está a la vista, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mira el corazón».
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «No pienses en lo bien que se ve ni en lo alto que es. Yo no lo he escogido. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ve las cosas como las ve la gente. La gente ve lo de afuera, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ve lo que hay dentro de una persona».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Ne regarde pas son apparence ni la hauteur de sa taille, car je l’ai rejeté. Car [il ne s’agit] pas de ce que voit {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} ; car {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} voit selon les yeux, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} voit selon le cœur. »
fr.B: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Ne fais pas attention à son allure ni à sa grande taille, car je l’ai rejeté. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne voit pas comme voit {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}. {{gender:L’être humain|L’homme}} regarde ce qui s’offre aux yeux, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regarde le cœur. »
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Samuel : « Ne pense pas à sa belle allure ni à sa grande taille. Ce n’est pas lui que j’ai choisi. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne voit pas les choses comme les gens. Les gens voient ce qui est à l’extérieur, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} voit ce qu’il y a à l’intérieur d’une personne. »

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Usiutazame uso wake wala urefu wa kimo chake, kwa maana nimemkataa. Kwa maana [si] kama mwanadamu aonavyo; kwa maana mwanadamu huona kwa macho, bali {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huona moyo."
sw.B: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Usijali sura yake wala urefu wake, kwa sababu nimemkataa. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haoni kama mwanadamu aonavyo. Mwanadamu hutazama kile kinachoonekana kwa macho, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hutazama moyo."
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Usifikiri juu ya jinsi alivyo mzuri wala jinsi alivyo mrefu. Sikumchagua yeye. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haoni mambo kama watu wanavyoona. Watu huona kilicho nje, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huona kilicho ndani ya mtu."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Đừng nhìn vẻ ngoài của nó hay chiều cao của vóc dáng nó, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã loại bỏ nó. Vì [không phải] như điều loài người thấy, vì loài người nhìn thấy bằng mắt, còn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn thấy tận lòng."
vi.B: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Đừng để ý đến diện mạo hay chiều cao của nó, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã loại bỏ nó. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không nhìn như loài người nhìn. Loài người nhìn những gì mắt thấy được, còn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn vào tấm lòng."
vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Đừng nghĩ đến vẻ đẹp hay chiều cao của nó. Ta không chọn nó. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không nhìn sự việc như người ta nhìn. Người ta nhìn bề ngoài, còn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn thấy bên trong con người."

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "그의 생김새와 그의 키가 큰 것을 보지 마라. 내가 이미 그를 버렸다. [나는] 사람이 보는 것과 같이 [보지] 않는다. 사람은 눈에 [보이는 것을] 보지만, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 마음을 본다."
ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "그의 겉모습이나 큰 키에 마음을 두지 마라. 나는 그를 버렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 사람이 보는 방식으로 보지 않는다. 사람은 눈에 보이는 것을 보지만, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 마음을 본다."
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "그가 얼마나 잘생겼는지, 얼마나 키가 큰지 생각하지 마라. 나는 그를 고르지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 사람처럼 보지 않는다. 사람은 겉모습을 보지만, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 사람의 속마음을 본다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Não olhes para a sua aparência nem para a altura da sua estatura, pois eu o rejeitei. Pois [não é] o que {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}} vê; pois {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}} vê o que [está] diante dos olhos, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vê o coração."
pt.B: Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Não te deixes levar pela aparência dele nem pela sua altura, porque eu o rejeitei. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não vê como {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}} vê. {{gender:O ser humano|O homem}} vê o que está diante dos olhos, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vê o coração."
pt.R: Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Não penses em como ele é bonito ou alto. Eu não o escolhi. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não vê as coisas como as pessoas veem. As pessoas veem o que está do lado de fora, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vê o que há dentro de cada um."

decisions.choice: his appearance and his height: the very things that marked Saul
decisions.reason: Saul had been chosen by a people who admired his looks and height (9:2; 10:23-24). Yahweh warns Samuel not to judge the same way again. "Rejected" is the word used of Saul himself (verse 1; 15:23, 26).

decisions.choice: for not what man sees: Yahweh does not see as a human being sees
alternatives: for it is not as man sees
decisions.reason: The wording is very short, "for not what man sees", and leaves the hearer to supply "does Yahweh see". The ancient Septuagint translation fills this out: God does not look as a human being looks. The rest of the verse makes the sense clear.

decisions.choice: sees to the eyes: looks at what the eyes can take in
decisions.reason: "To the eyes" means what is open to view: looks, size, bearing. The phrase may also mean that a person looks no further than the eyes can reach.

decisions.choice: Yahweh sees to the heart: he judges the inner person
decisions.reason: In Scripture the heart is the inner life: thought, will, desire and loyalty. Samuel had told Saul that Yahweh sought "a man after his own heart" (13:14). Yahweh's choice rests on what a person is within, which only he can see (16:12 notes that David was handsome too, but that is not why he is chosen; 1 Kings 8:39; Jeremiah 17:10).

decisions.choice: the man: human beings in general
decisions.reason: The word here is the general word for a human being, set against Yahweh. Women and men alike are meant.

decisions.choice: a human being / a person (alternative: man)
decisions.reason: The inclusive form is the default because the word means any human being (m5); the gender setting gives the traditional "man". Readable's "people" is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: The LORD does not see in the way a person sees
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the words the Hebrew leaves the hearer to add (m2).

decisions.choice: I have not chosen him
decisions.reason: Readable puts "I have rejected him" positively: Eliab is not the one Yahweh has chosen. It also says "inside a person" for "the heart" (m4).

decisions.choice: {{gender:l'être humain|l'homme}}
decisions.reason: The word means any human being (m5); French "l'homme" is read as generic less and less, so the inclusive form is the default and the traditional word the alternative, as the French style guide sets. Readable says "les gens", already inclusive, with no span.

decisions.choice: {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}}
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general (m5). Spanish has two wordings, as the English has (r-en-1): “el ser humano” by default, “el hombre” as the alternative. Readable says “la gente”, which needs no span.

decisions.choice: "mwanadamu" (L, B), "watu" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "mwanadamu" already means any human being (m5), so there is no second wording for the gender setting to offer; the English span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "loài người" (L, B), "người ta" (R)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "loài người" and "người ta" already mean human beings of either sex, so there are not two wordings to choose between (style guide section 7); this holds through the block.

decisions.choice: "사람" for the general word for a human being, with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already means any human being, woman or man (meaning decision m5), so Korean has no second wording for the gender setting to offer, unlike the English "a human being / man".

decisions.choice: vê o que [está] diante dos olhos ... vê o coração
alternatives: vê para os olhos ... vê para o coração
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew "sees to the eyes ... sees to the heart" (m3, m4): "o que está diante dos olhos" says what lies open to view, and Literal brackets only "está"; the familiar printed wordings of this saying are avoided. The two clauses keep the same verb, "vê", so that the contrast rests on what is seen.

decisions.choice: o ser humano (alternative: o homem)
decisions.reason: As the English: the word means any human being (m5), so the gender setting gives "o ser humano" by default and the traditional "o homem" as the alternative; Readable's "as pessoas" is already inclusive.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֤א יִשַׁי֙ אֶל־אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֖הוּ לִפְנֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶ֖ה לֹֽא־בָחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Jesse Abinadab and made him pass before Samuel, and he said, Also this [one] not has chosen Yahweh.

en.L: And Jesse called Abinadab and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen this one either."
en.B: Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him walk past Samuel. But Samuel said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen this one either."
en.R: Then Jesse called his son Abinadab and had him walk in front of Samuel. But Samuel said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen this one either."

es.L: Y llamó Isaí a Abinadab y lo hizo pasar delante de Samuel. Y él dijo: «Tampoco a este ha escogido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Entonces Isaí llamó a Abinadab y lo hizo pasar delante de Samuel. Pero Samuel dijo: «Tampoco a este lo ha escogido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Entonces Isaí llamó a su hijo Abinadab y lo hizo pasar delante de Samuel. Pero Samuel dijo: «Tampoco a este lo ha escogido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et Jessé appela Abinadab et le fit passer devant Samuel. Et il dit : « Celui-ci non plus, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne l’a pas choisi. »
fr.B: Jessé appela alors Abinadab et le fit passer devant Samuel. Mais Samuel dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas choisi celui-là non plus. »
fr.R: Ensuite, Jessé a appelé son fils Abinadab et l’a fait passer devant Samuel. Mais Samuel a dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas choisi celui-là non plus. »

sw.L: Yese akamwita Abinadabu, akampitisha mbele ya Samweli. Akasema, "Huyu naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakumchagua."
sw.B: Kisha Yese akamwita Abinadabu, akampitisha mbele ya Samweli. Lakini Samweli akasema, "Huyu naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakumchagua."
sw.R: Kisha Yese akamwita mwanawe Abinadabu, akampitisha mbele ya Samweli. Lakini Samweli akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakumchagua huyu pia."

vi.L: Gie-sê gọi A-bi-na-đáp và cho nó đi qua trước mặt Sa-mu-ên. Ông nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng không chọn người này."
vi.B: Rồi Gie-sê gọi A-bi-na-đáp và cho đi ngang qua trước mặt Sa-mu-ên. Nhưng Sa-mu-ên nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng không chọn người này."
vi.R: Rồi Gie-sê gọi con trai mình là A-bi-na-đáp và cho đi qua trước mặt Sa-mu-ên. Nhưng Sa-mu-ên nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng không chọn người này."

ko.L: 그리고 이새가 아비나답을 불러 사무엘 앞으로 지나가게 했다. 그러자 그가 말했다. "이 사람도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하지 않으셨다."
ko.B: 이새가 아비나답을 불러 사무엘 앞으로 지나가게 했다. 그러나 사무엘은 "이 아들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고르지 않으셨다" 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 그러자 이새는 아들 아비나답을 불러 사무엘 앞으로 걸어가게 했다. 그러나 사무엘은 "이 아들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고르지 않으셨다" 하고 말했다.

pt.L: E Jessé chamou Abinadabe e o fez passar diante de Samuel. E ele disse: "Também a este {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não escolheu."
pt.B: Então Jessé chamou Abinadabe e o fez passar diante de Samuel. Mas Samuel disse: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} também não escolheu este."
pt.R: Então Jessé chamou o seu filho Abinadabe e o fez passar na frente de Samuel. Mas Samuel disse: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} também não escolheu este."

decisions.choice: made him pass before Samuel: presented him for Samuel to look at
decisions.reason: Each son is brought in turn past the prophet, who waits for Yahweh to show him the one (verse 3).

decisions.choice: Abinadab: Jesse's second son
decisions.reason: Abinadab is the second son, after Eliab (17:13; 1 Chronicles 2:13).

decisions.choice: his son
decisions.reason: Readable says that Abinadab is Jesse's son.

source.text: וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר יִשַׁ֖י שַׁמָּ֑ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם־בָּזֶ֖ה לֹא־בָחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And made pass Jesse Shammah, and he said, Also this [one] not has chosen Yahweh.

en.L: And Jesse made Shammah pass by. And he said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen this one either."
en.B: Next Jesse had Shammah walk past. But Samuel said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen this one either."
en.R: Next Jesse had Shammah walk past. But Samuel said again, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen this one either."

es.L: E hizo pasar Isaí a Sama. Y él dijo: «Tampoco a este ha escogido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Después Isaí hizo pasar a Sama. Pero Samuel dijo: «Tampoco a este lo ha escogido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Después Isaí hizo pasar a Sama. Pero Samuel volvió a decir: «Tampoco a este lo ha escogido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et Jessé fit passer Shamma. Et il dit : « Celui-ci non plus, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne l’a pas choisi. »
fr.B: Jessé fit ensuite passer Shamma. Mais Samuel dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas choisi celui-là non plus. »
fr.R: Ensuite, Jessé a fait passer Shamma. Mais Samuel a dit encore : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas choisi celui-là non plus. »

sw.L: Yese akampitisha Shama. Akasema, "Huyu naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakumchagua."
sw.B: Kisha Yese akampitisha Shama. Lakini Samweli akasema, "Huyu naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakumchagua."
sw.R: Kisha Yese akampitisha Shama. Lakini Samweli akasema tena, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakumchagua huyu pia."

vi.L: Gie-sê cho Sam-ma đi qua. Ông nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng không chọn người này."
vi.B: Kế đến Gie-sê cho Sam-ma đi ngang qua. Nhưng Sa-mu-ên nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng không chọn người này."
vi.R: Kế đến Gie-sê cho Sam-ma đi qua. Nhưng Sa-mu-ên lại nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng không chọn người này."

ko.L: 그리고 이새가 삼마를 지나가게 했다. 그러자 그가 말했다. "이 사람도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 택하지 않으셨다."
ko.B: 이새가 다음으로 삼마를 지나가게 했다. 그러나 사무엘은 "이 아들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고르지 않으셨다" 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 이새는 다음으로 삼마를 지나가게 했다. 그러나 사무엘은 또 "이 아들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고르지 않으셨다" 하고 말했다.

pt.L: E Jessé fez passar Samá. E ele disse: "Também a este {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não escolheu."
pt.B: Depois Jessé fez passar Samá. Mas Samuel disse: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} também não escolheu este."
pt.R: Depois Jessé fez Samá passar. Mas Samuel disse de novo: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} também não escolheu este."

decisions.choice: Shammah: Jesse's third son
decisions.reason: He is the third son (17:13). Elsewhere his name appears as Shimea or Shimeah (2 Samuel 13:3; 1 Chronicles 2:13), forms of the same name.

decisions.choice: the same words as verse 8
decisions.reason: The answer is repeated word for word; the story slows down to show son after son passing by.

decisions.choice: Shamma
decisions.reason: The usual French transcription of the name; it is kept through both books of Samuel (m1 notes the other forms of the name).

decisions.choice: Sama
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of Shammah, Jesse's third son (m1); it stays the same wherever he is named.

source.text: וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר יִשַׁ֛י שִׁבְעַ֥ת בָּנָ֖יו לִפְנֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־יִשַׁ֔י לֹא־בָחַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בָּאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And made pass Jesse seven of his sons before Samuel, and said Samuel to Jesse, Not has chosen Yahweh these.

en.L: And Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen these."
en.B: Jesse had seven of his sons walk past Samuel, but Samuel said to Jesse, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen any of these."
en.R: In this way Jesse had seven of his sons walk past Samuel. But Samuel told Jesse, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not chosen any of these."

es.L: E hizo pasar Isaí a siete de sus hijos delante de Samuel. Y dijo Samuel a Isaí: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha escogido a estos».
es.B: Isaí hizo pasar a siete de sus hijos delante de Samuel, pero Samuel le dijo a Isaí: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha escogido a ninguno de estos».
es.R: Así Isaí hizo pasar a siete de sus hijos delante de Samuel. Pero Samuel le dijo a Isaí: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha escogido a ninguno de estos».

fr.L: Et Jessé fit passer sept de ses fils devant Samuel. Et Samuel dit à Jessé : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas choisi ceux-ci. »
fr.B: Jessé fit passer sept de ses fils devant Samuel, mais Samuel dit à Jessé : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a choisi aucun d’eux. »
fr.R: Jessé a donc fait passer sept de ses fils devant Samuel. Mais Samuel a dit à Jessé : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a choisi aucun d’eux. »

sw.L: Yese akawapitisha wanawe saba mbele ya Samweli. Samweli akamwambia Yese, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakuwachagua hawa."
sw.B: Yese akawapitisha wanawe saba mbele ya Samweli, lakini Samweli akamwambia Yese, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakumchagua yeyote kati ya hawa."
sw.R: Hivyo Yese akawapitisha wanawe saba mbele ya Samweli. Lakini Samweli akamwambia Yese, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakumchagua yeyote kati ya hawa."

vi.L: Gie-sê cho bảy người con trai mình đi qua trước mặt Sa-mu-ên. Sa-mu-ên nói với Gie-sê: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không chọn những người này."
vi.B: Gie-sê cho bảy người con trai mình đi ngang qua trước mặt Sa-mu-ên, nhưng Sa-mu-ên nói với Gie-sê: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không chọn ai trong những người này cả."
vi.R: Cứ như thế, Gie-sê cho bảy người con trai mình đi qua trước mặt Sa-mu-ên. Nhưng Sa-mu-ên bảo Gie-sê: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không chọn ai trong những người này cả."

ko.L: 그리고 이새가 그의 아들 일곱을 사무엘 앞으로 지나가게 했다. 그러자 사무엘이 이새에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이들을 택하지 않으셨다."
ko.B: 이새는 아들 일곱을 사무엘 앞으로 지나가게 했다. 그러나 사무엘은 이새에게 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이들 가운데 아무도 고르지 않으셨다" 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 이렇게 이새는 아들 일곱을 사무엘 앞으로 지나가게 했다. 그러나 사무엘은 이새에게 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이들 가운데 아무도 고르지 않으셨다" 하고 말했다.

pt.L: E Jessé fez passar sete dos seus filhos diante de Samuel. E Samuel disse a Jessé: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não escolheu estes."
pt.B: Jessé fez passar sete dos seus filhos diante de Samuel, mas Samuel disse a Jessé: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não escolheu nenhum destes."
pt.R: Assim, Jessé fez passar sete dos seus filhos na frente de Samuel. Mas Samuel disse a Jessé: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não escolheu nenhum deles."

decisions.choice: seven of his sons: all the sons present, Eliab and the others
decisions.reason: Verses 6-9 name the first three; this verse sums up the whole line. Seven sons are present and one is missing, for Jesse had eight sons (17:12). 1 Chronicles 2:13-15 lists only seven, with David as the seventh; one son may have died without children.

decisions.choice: seven: a full number, yet not the one
decisions.reason: Seven is often the number of completeness. Seven sons would seem a full family, yet Yahweh's choice is outside it.

decisions.choice: any of
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "any of" to make clear that none of the seven is chosen.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל אֶל־יִשַׁי֮ הֲתַ֣מּוּ הַנְּעָרִים֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר ע֚וֹד שָׁאַ֣ר הַקָּטָ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֥ה רֹעֶ֖ה בַּצֹּ֑אן וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־יִשַׁי֙ שִׁלְחָ֣ה וְקָחֶ֔נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־נָסֹ֖ב עַד־בֹּא֥וֹ פֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel to Jesse, Are finished the young men? And he said, Still remains the small [one], and there, he [is] shepherding with the flock. And said Samuel to Jesse, Send and bring him, for not we will go around until his coming here.

en.L: And Samuel said to Jesse, "Are the young men finished?" And he said, "There still remains the youngest, and look, he is shepherding the flock." And Samuel said to Jesse, "Send and bring him, for we will not go around until he comes here."
en.B: Then Samuel asked Jesse, "Are these all the boys you have?" Jesse answered, "There is still the youngest. He is out looking after the sheep." Samuel said to Jesse, "Send for him and bring him here. We will not sit down to eat until he comes."
en.R: Then Samuel asked Jesse, "Are these all the sons you have?" Jesse answered, "There is still the youngest one, but he is out in the fields taking care of the sheep." Samuel said, "Send someone to bring him. We will not sit down to the feast until he gets here."

es.L: Y dijo Samuel a Isaí: «¿Se han acabado los jóvenes?». Y él dijo: «Todavía queda el menor, y he aquí que está apacentando el rebaño». Y dijo Samuel a Isaí: «Manda a traerlo, porque no nos sentaremos alrededor hasta que él venga aquí».
es.B: Entonces Samuel le preguntó a Isaí: «¿Son estos todos los muchachos que tienes?». Isaí respondió: «Todavía queda el menor. Está afuera cuidando las ovejas». Samuel le dijo a Isaí: «Manda a buscarlo y tráelo aquí. No nos sentaremos a comer hasta que él llegue».
es.R: Entonces Samuel le preguntó a Isaí: «¿Son estos todos los hijos que tienes?». Isaí contestó: «Todavía queda el más pequeño, pero está en el campo cuidando las ovejas». Samuel dijo: «Manda a alguien a traerlo. No nos sentaremos a la fiesta hasta que él llegue».

fr.L: Et Samuel dit à Jessé : « Les jeunes gens sont-ils au complet ? » Et il dit : « Il reste encore le petit, et voici, il fait paître le troupeau. » Et Samuel dit à Jessé : « Envoie [quelqu’un] et fais-le venir, car nous ne nous mettrons pas autour [de la table] avant qu’il soit venu ici. »
fr.B: Samuel demanda alors à Jessé : « Est-ce là tous tes garçons ? » Jessé répondit : « Il reste encore le plus jeune. Il est à garder les moutons. » Samuel dit à Jessé : « Envoie-le chercher et fais-le venir. Nous ne nous mettrons pas à table avant qu’il soit arrivé. »
fr.R: Alors Samuel a demandé à Jessé : « Est-ce que ce sont tous tes fils ? » Jessé a répondu : « Il reste encore le plus jeune, mais il est dans les champs, il garde les moutons. » Samuel a dit : « Envoie quelqu’un le chercher. Nous ne commencerons pas le repas avant qu’il soit arrivé. »

sw.L: Samweli akamwambia Yese, "Je, vijana wamekwisha?" Akasema, "Bado amebaki mdogo, na tazama, anachunga kondoo." Samweli akamwambia Yese, "Tuma umlete, kwa maana hatutazunguka mpaka atakapokuja hapa."
sw.B: Kisha Samweli akamwuliza Yese, "Je, hawa ndio vijana wako wote?" Yese akajibu, "Bado yupo mdogo kuliko wote. Yuko nje anachunga kondoo." Samweli akamwambia Yese, "Mtumie mtu amlete hapa. Hatutaketi kula mpaka atakapofika."
sw.R: Kisha Samweli akamwuliza Yese, "Je, hawa ndio wanao wote?" Yese akajibu, "Bado yupo yule mdogo kuliko wote, lakini yuko nje mashambani akichunga kondoo." Samweli akasema, "Tuma mtu amlete. Hatutaketi kwa karamu mpaka atakapofika hapa."

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói với Gie-sê: "Các chàng trai đã hết chưa?" Ông ấy nói: "Còn lại đứa nhỏ nhất, và kìa, nó đang chăn bầy chiên." Sa-mu-ên nói với Gie-sê: "Hãy sai [người] đem nó đến, vì chúng ta sẽ không ngồi quanh [bàn] cho đến khi nó đến đây."
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên hỏi Gie-sê: "Ông chỉ có ngần này con trai thôi sao?" Gie-sê đáp: "Còn đứa út nữa. Nó đang ở ngoài chăn chiên." Sa-mu-ên nói với Gie-sê: "Hãy cho người gọi nó về đây. Chúng ta sẽ không ngồi vào bữa ăn cho đến khi nó đến."
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên hỏi Gie-sê: "Ông chỉ có bấy nhiêu con trai thôi sao?" Gie-sê đáp: "Còn đứa út nữa, nhưng nó đang ở ngoài đồng chăn chiên." Sa-mu-ên nói: "Hãy sai người đi gọi nó về. Chúng ta sẽ không ngồi vào bữa tiệc cho đến khi nó đến đây."

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 이새에게 말했다. "젊은이들이 다 [왔느냐]?" 그러자 그가 말했다. "아직 막내가 남아 있는데, 보십시오, 그는 양 떼를 치고 있습니다." 그러자 사무엘이 이새에게 말했다. "사람을 보내어 그를 데려오너라. 그가 여기에 올 때까지 우리는 둘러앉지 않겠다."
ko.B: 사무엘이 이새에게 물었다. "아들이 이들뿐이냐?" 이새가 대답했다. "아직 막내가 있습니다. 그 아이는 지금 양 떼를 돌보고 있습니다." 사무엘이 이새에게 말했다. "사람을 보내어 그를 데려오너라. 그가 올 때까지 우리는 식사 자리에 앉지 않겠다."
ko.R: 사무엘이 이새에게 물었다. "아들이 이들뿐이냐?" 이새가 대답했다. "막내가 하나 더 있습니다. 그런데 그 아이는 들에 나가 양을 치고 있습니다." 사무엘이 말했다. "사람을 보내서 그를 데려오너라. 그가 여기 올 때까지 우리는 잔치 자리에 앉지 않겠다."

pt.L: E Samuel disse a Jessé: "Acabaram-se os rapazes?" E ele disse: "Ainda resta o menor, e eis que ele está apascentando o rebanho." E Samuel disse a Jessé: "Mande buscá-lo e traga-o, pois não nos poremos ao redor [da mesa] até que ele chegue aqui."
pt.B: Então Samuel perguntou a Jessé: "Estes são todos os rapazes que você tem?" Jessé respondeu: "Ainda falta o mais novo. Ele está cuidando das ovelhas." Samuel disse a Jessé: "Mande buscá-lo e trazê-lo aqui. Não vamos nos sentar para comer até que ele chegue."
pt.R: Então Samuel perguntou a Jessé: "Estes são todos os filhos que você tem?" Jessé respondeu: "Ainda há o mais novo, mas ele está no campo, cuidando das ovelhas." Samuel disse: "Mande alguém buscá-lo. Não vamos nos sentar para a festa até que ele chegue."

decisions.choice: the small one: the youngest, and also the least
decisions.reason: The word means both "youngest" and "small". After verse 7 the reader hears both: the son no one thought to call is the smallest in his family's eyes, the opposite of tall Eliab. Saul too once called himself the least (9:21).

decisions.choice: shepherding the flock: the work of the least important son
decisions.reason: Watching the sheep was left to the youngest. Jesse did not think him worth calling. Shepherd was also a picture of a king (2 Samuel 5:2; Psalm 78:70-72).

decisions.choice: we will not go around: we will not sit down to the meal
alternatives: we will not go around the altar
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn or go around. It may mean taking places around the table for the sacrificial meal (verse 5), or going around the altar, or turning away to leave. Each way, nothing goes forward until the youngest comes.

decisions.choice: the young men: Jesse's sons
decisions.reason: The word is used of boys and young men; here it means the sons who passed by.

decisions.choice: sit down to eat / sit down to the feast
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the likeliest sense (m3); Literal keeps "go around".

decisions.choice: out in the fields
decisions.reason: Readable says where the sheep were kept.

decisions.choice: le petit (L); le plus jeune (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "le petit", which in French means both the smallest and the youngest, as the Hebrew word does (m1); Balanced and Readable say "le plus jeune".

decisions.choice: nous ne nous mettrons pas autour [de la table] (L); nous ne nous mettrons pas à table (B); nous ne commencerons pas le repas (R)
alternatives: nous ne ferons pas le tour
decisions.reason: French cannot leave "go around" without an object; Literal supplies the table in brackets, following the likeliest sense (m3), and Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

decisions.choice: no nos sentaremos a comer / a la fiesta
decisions.reason: “We will not go around” means sitting down around the table for the sacrificial meal (m3), as the English Balanced and Readable say (r-en-1). Literal keeps “sentarnos alrededor”.

decisions.choice: "mdogo"
decisions.reason: "Mdogo" means both "small" and "the younger", so Literal keeps the double sense the meaning decision points to (m1); Balanced and Readable add "kuliko wote" (the youngest).

decisions.choice: "ngồi quanh [bàn]" (L); "ngồi vào bữa ăn" (B); "ngồi vào bữa tiệc" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb "go around" means sitting round the meal (m3); Literal keeps the picture with a bracketed word, the other levels say what it means.

decisions.choice: "식사 자리에 앉지 않겠다" / "잔치 자리에 앉지 않겠다" (sit down to the meal) at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps "둘러앉지 않겠다"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "go around" means sitting around the sacrificial meal (meaning decision m3); Literal's "둘러앉다" (sit around) keeps the picture, the other levels say it plainly.

decisions.choice: o menor
decisions.reason: Literal says "o menor", which in Portuguese, like the Hebrew word, means both the youngest and the smallest (m1); Balanced and Readable say "o mais novo", the plain sense.

decisions.choice: não nos poremos ao redor [da mesa]
decisions.reason: "Go around" alone makes no sense in Portuguese; Literal keeps the picture of going around and brackets the table, the likeliest sense (m3).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח וַיְבִיאֵ֨הוּ֙ וְה֣וּא אַדְמוֹנִ֔י עִם־יְפֵ֥ה עֵינַ֖יִם וְט֣וֹב רֹ֑אִיפוַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה ק֥וּם מְשָׁחֵ֖הוּ כִּֽי־זֶ֥ה הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And he sent and brought him, and he [was] ruddy, with beautiful eyes and good of appearance. And said Yahweh, Arise, anoint him, for this [is] he.

en.L: And he sent and brought him in. And he [was] ruddy, with beautiful eyes, and good in appearance. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Arise, anoint him, for this [is] he."
en.B: So Jesse sent for him and had him brought in. He had a healthy, glowing look, with fine eyes, and he was handsome. Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Get up and anoint him. He is the one."
en.R: So Jesse sent for him and brought him in. His skin glowed with health, he had beautiful eyes, and he was good-looking. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Get up and pour the oil on him. He is the one."

es.L: Y mandó a traerlo. Y él [era] rubio, de hermosos ojos y de buen parecer. Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: «Levántate, úngelo, porque este [es] él».
es.B: Isaí mandó a buscarlo e hizo que lo trajeran. Tenía un aspecto sano y radiante, ojos hermosos y buena presencia. Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «Levántate y úngelo. Él es».
es.R: Isaí mandó a buscarlo y lo trajeron. Su piel brillaba de salud, tenía ojos hermosos y era bien parecido. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «Levántate y derrama el aceite sobre él. Él es el elegido».

fr.L: Et il envoya [quelqu’un] et le fit venir. Et il [était] roux, avec de beaux yeux et beau d’apparence. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « Lève-toi, oins-le, car c’est lui. »
fr.B: Jessé l’envoya donc chercher et le fit entrer. Il avait le teint frais et vermeil, de beaux yeux et une belle apparence. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit alors : « Lève-toi et oins-le : c’est lui. »
fr.R: Jessé l’a donc envoyé chercher et l’a fait venir. Il avait un teint plein de santé, de beaux yeux, et il était beau garçon. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Samuel : « Lève-toi et verse l’huile sur sa tête. C’est lui. »

sw.L: Akatuma, akamleta ndani. Naye [alikuwa] mwekundu, mwenye macho mazuri, na mwenye sura nzuri. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Inuka, umpake mafuta, kwa maana huyu ndiye."
sw.B: Basi Yese akatuma aletwe ndani. Alikuwa na sura ya afya inayong'aa, macho mazuri, naye alikuwa mzuri wa umbo. Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Inuka umpake mafuta. Huyu ndiye."
sw.R: Basi Yese akatuma mtu, akamleta. Ngozi yake ilikuwa iking'aa kwa afya, alikuwa na macho mazuri, naye alikuwa mzuri wa sura. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Inuka umwagie mafuta. Huyu ndiye."

vi.L: Ông sai [người] đem cậu đến. Cậu có nước da hồng hào, đôi mắt đẹp và dáng vẻ đẹp đẽ. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Hãy đứng dậy, xức dầu cho nó, vì chính là nó."
vi.B: Vậy Gie-sê sai người đưa cậu về. Cậu có vẻ khỏe mạnh, nước da hồng hào, đôi mắt sáng đẹp, dáng người tuấn tú. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Hãy đứng dậy xức dầu cho nó. Chính nó đó."
vi.R: Vậy Gie-sê sai người đưa cậu về. Da cậu hồng hào khỏe mạnh, mắt cậu đẹp, và cậu rất đẹp trai. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy đứng dậy đổ dầu trên nó. Chính nó đó."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 사람을 보내어 그를 데려왔다. 그는 붉은빛이 돌고 눈이 아름답고 보기에 좋았다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "일어나 그에게 기름을 부어라. 바로 이 사람이다."
ko.B: 이새가 사람을 보내어 그를 데려왔다. 그는 혈색이 좋고 눈이 빛났으며 용모가 잘생겼다. 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "일어나 그에게 기름을 부어라. 바로 이 사람이다."
ko.R: 이새는 사람을 보내 막내를 데려왔다. 그의 얼굴은 건강하게 빛났고 눈이 아름다웠으며 잘생긴 모습이었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "일어나 그의 머리에 기름을 부어라. 바로 이 사람이다."

pt.L: E ele mandou [buscá-lo] e o trouxe. E ele [era] ruivo, de olhos bonitos e de boa aparência. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Levanta-te, unge-o, pois este [é] ele."
pt.B: Então Jessé mandou buscá-lo e o fez entrar. Ele era ruivo, de olhos bonitos e de boa aparência. Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Levanta-te e unge-o. É ele."
pt.R: Então Jessé mandou buscá-lo e o trouxe. A pele dele era corada e cheia de saúde, ele tinha olhos bonitos e boa aparência. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Samuel: "Levanta-te e derrama o azeite sobre ele. É ele."

decisions.choice: ruddy: reddish in color
decisions.reason: The word comes from the root for "red" and is also used of Esau at birth (Genesis 25:25). It may describe a fresh, reddish complexion or reddish hair. It is said again of David in 17:42.

decisions.choice: David is handsome too, but that is not why he is chosen
decisions.reason: After verse 7 the writer notes David's good looks without making them the reason for Yahweh's choice. Yahweh has seen his heart; the looks are given as a matter of fact.

decisions.choice: this is he: the one Yahweh had promised to show
decisions.reason: Yahweh now does what he said in verse 3: he names the one Samuel is to anoint.

decisions.choice: a healthy, glowing look / his skin glowed with health
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the sense of a fresh, reddish complexion (m1) rather than the rare English word "ruddy", which Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: pour the oil on him
decisions.reason: Readable says what "anoint" means, as in verse 3, and says whom Yahweh spoke to.

decisions.choice: roux (L); le teint frais et vermeil (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the root sense "red" (m1); Balanced follows the likeliest sense, a fresh, reddish complexion, as the English Balanced does, without deciding on the colour of his hair.

decisions.choice: rubio
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is “reddish” (m1). Literal uses “rubio” in its old sense of reddish, as Genesis 25:25 does for Esau; Balanced and Readable describe a healthy, glowing look, as the English does (r-en-1). Whether hair or skin is meant is left open.

decisions.choice: "mwekundu" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the colour word, "red, ruddy", which in Swahili can describe a light, reddish complexion; Balanced and Readable say what it suggests, a healthy glow (m1).

decisions.choice: the narrator calls the young David "cậu" until he enters Saul's service; from 16:21 on he is "ông", as the published Psalm titles speak of him
decisions.reason: "cậu" fits a youth sent for from the flock; switching to "ông" once he serves the king keeps the narration in line with the Psalm titles (Psalms 34; 57; 59) and with 2 Samuel.

decisions.choice: "혈색이 좋고" (healthy complexion) at Balanced, "얼굴은 건강하게 빛났고" at Readable for "ruddy"; Literal "붉은빛이 돌고"
decisions.reason: Korean "붉다" alone would suggest red hair or a flushed face; the meaning decision (m1) reads the word as a healthy reddish colour, which Balanced and Readable state.

decisions.choice: ruivo, de olhos bonitos
decisions.reason: The English Balanced avoids the rare "ruddy"; Portuguese "ruivo" is an everyday word for reddish colouring, of hair above all, which is one of the two readings of the Hebrew (m1), so Balanced keeps it with Literal. Readable follows the English Readable's other reading, a fresh, reddish complexion ("corada e cheia de saúde").

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶת־קֶ֣רֶן הַשֶּׁ֗מֶן וַיִּמְשַׁ֣ח אֹתוֹ֮ בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֶחָיו֒ וַתִּצְלַ֤ח רֽוּחַ־יְהוָה֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֔ד מֵהַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא וָמָ֑עְלָה וַיָּ֣קָם שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ הָרָמָֽתָה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And took Samuel [the] horn of the oil and anointed him in [the] midst of his brothers, and rushed [the] Spirit of Yahweh on David from the day the that and onward. And arose Samuel and went [to] Ramah.

en.L: And Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers. And the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rushed on David from that day and onward. And Samuel arose and went to Ramah.
en.B: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him there among his brothers, and the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rushed on David from that day on. Then Samuel set out and went back to Ramah.
en.R: So Samuel took the horn of oil and poured it on David's head while his brothers watched. From that day on, the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came on David with power. Then Samuel left and went home to Ramah.

es.L: Y tomó Samuel el cuerno del aceite y lo ungió en medio de sus hermanos. Y el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino con poder sobre David desde aquel día en adelante. Y se levantó Samuel y se fue a Ramá.
es.B: Samuel tomó el cuerno de aceite y lo ungió allí, en medio de sus hermanos, y desde aquel día el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino con poder sobre David. Luego Samuel se puso en camino y regresó a Ramá.
es.R: Samuel tomó el cuerno de aceite y lo derramó sobre la cabeza de David mientras sus hermanos miraban. Desde aquel día, el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino con poder sobre David. Después Samuel se fue a su casa en Ramá.

fr.L: Et Samuel prit la corne d’huile et l’oignit au milieu de ses frères. Et l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fondit sur David à partir de ce jour-là et dans la suite. Et Samuel se leva et s’en alla à Rama.
fr.B: Samuel prit donc la corne d’huile et l’oignit là, au milieu de ses frères, et l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fondit sur David à partir de ce jour. Puis Samuel se mit en route et retourna à Rama.
fr.R: Alors Samuel a pris la corne d’huile et l’a versée sur la tête de David, devant ses frères. À partir de ce jour-là, l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est venu sur David avec puissance. Puis Samuel est parti et il est rentré chez lui, à Rama.

sw.L: Samweli akaichukua pembe ya mafuta, akampaka mafuta katikati ya ndugu zake. Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamjia Daudi kwa nguvu tangu siku ile na kuendelea. Samweli akainuka, akaenda Rama.
sw.B: Basi Samweli akachukua pembe ya mafuta, akampaka mafuta pale katikati ya ndugu zake. Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamjia Daudi kwa nguvu tangu siku ile. Kisha Samweli akaondoka, akarudi Rama.
sw.R: Basi Samweli akachukua pembe ya mafuta, akammiminia Daudi kichwani ndugu zake wakitazama. Tangu siku ile, Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaja juu ya Daudi kwa nguvu. Kisha Samweli akaondoka, akarudi nyumbani Rama.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên lấy sừng dầu và xức dầu cho cậu giữa các anh của cậu. Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng mạnh trên Đa-vít từ ngày đó trở đi. Sa-mu-ên đứng dậy đi về Ra-ma.
vi.B: Vậy Sa-mu-ên lấy sừng dầu và xức dầu cho cậu ngay giữa các anh của cậu, và Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng mạnh trên Đa-vít từ ngày đó trở đi. Rồi Sa-mu-ên lên đường trở về Ra-ma.
vi.R: Vậy Sa-mu-ên lấy sừng dầu đổ trên đầu Đa-vít trong khi các anh cậu đứng nhìn. Từ ngày đó trở đi, Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến trên Đa-vít với quyền năng. Rồi Sa-mu-ên rời đi và trở về nhà mình ở Ra-ma.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 기름 뿔을 가져다가 그의 형들 가운데에서 그에게 기름을 부었다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그날부터 계속 다윗에게 크게 임했다. 그리고 사무엘은 일어나 라마로 갔다.
ko.B: 사무엘은 기름이 담긴 뿔을 가져다가 그의 형들이 있는 자리에서 그에게 기름을 부었다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그날부터 다윗에게 크게 임했다. 그 뒤에 사무엘은 일어나 라마로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 사무엘은 기름이 담긴 뿔을 가져다가, 형들이 보는 앞에서 다윗의 머리에 기름을 부었다. 그날부터 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 다윗에게 힘 있게 임했다. 그 뒤에 사무엘은 자기 집이 있는 라마로 돌아갔다.

pt.L: E Samuel tomou o chifre do azeite e o ungiu no meio dos seus irmãos. E o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} irrompeu sobre Davi daquele dia em diante. E Samuel se levantou e foi para Ramá.
pt.B: Então Samuel pegou o chifre de azeite e o ungiu ali, no meio dos seus irmãos, e daquele dia em diante o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio com força sobre Davi. Depois Samuel partiu e voltou para Ramá.
pt.R: Então Samuel pegou o chifre de azeite e o derramou sobre a cabeça de Davi, enquanto os irmãos dele olhavam. Daquele dia em diante, o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio com força sobre Davi. Depois Samuel partiu e voltou para casa, em Ramá.

decisions.choice: David: the name is given only now
decisions.reason: Through the whole scene the youngest son has had no name. The writer names him for the first time at the moment the Spirit comes on him. From here on, the story of the books of Samuel is the story of David.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of Yahweh rushed on David: came on him with power
decisions.reason: The verb means to rush in or break through. It is used of the Spirit coming on Samson (Judges 14:6, 19; 15:14) and on Saul (10:6, 10; 11:6). With Saul and Samson it came at certain moments; here it stays with David "from that day and onward".

decisions.choice: in the midst of his brothers: with his brothers present
decisions.reason: The anointing takes place in front of the family. Nothing is said of what they understood; Eliab's anger in 17:28 suggests he did not accept it.

decisions.choice: Ramah: Samuel's home town
decisions.reason: Ramah, in the hill country of Ephraim, was Samuel's home (1:19; 7:17; 15:34).

decisions.choice: poured it on David's head while his brothers watched
decisions.reason: Readable explains anointing and "in the midst of his brothers" (m3), and names David as the one anointed.

decisions.choice: came on David with power
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "rushed on" means (m2); Literal and Balanced keep "rushed on", as Judges 14:6 does.

decisions.choice: fondit sur
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets: "fondit sur" keeps the sudden, forceful movement of the verb (m2), used of the Spirit on Saul and Samson; Readable says it plainly, "est venu sur David avec puissance", as the English (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: vino con poder sobre
decisions.reason: The wording the Samuel terms note sets for the Spirit of the LORD rushing on someone (m2), at every level; recorded once for this block.

decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's form for the Spirit rushing on someone; Readable uses plainer words, as the English Readable "came on David with power".

decisions.choice: "주의 영이 ... 크게 임했다" for "the Spirit of the LORD rushed on"; Readable "힘 있게 임했다"
decisions.reason: The form this translation settles for 1 and 2 Samuel: the Spirit comes on a person with sudden power (meaning decision m2), without a verb of attack. Readable says "with power" in plainer words.

decisions.choice: irrompeu sobre (L); veio com força sobre (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Judges 14:6 and 1 Samuel 10:6 in Portuguese: Literal "irrompeu", Balanced and Readable "veio com força", the wording used for the same verb when the Spirit came on Saul.

pt.B: Ora, o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tinha se afastado de Saul, e um espírito mau da parte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} o atormentava.
pt.R: Mas o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tinha deixado Saul. Em vez dele, um espírito mau enviado {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}} enchia Saul de terror.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of Yahweh left Saul: the gift that made him king was taken away
decisions.reason: The Spirit that rushed on Saul at the start of his reign (10:6, 10; 11:6) now leaves him, just as it comes on David (verse 13). The two verses are set side by side: one king rises as the other falls. Saul is still on the throne, but Yahweh's power is no longer with him (18:12; 28:15).

decisions.choice: an evil spirit: a spirit that brings harm and distress
decisions.reason: The word ra'ah can mean moral evil, but also harm, trouble or disaster (Amos 3:6; Isaiah 45:7), as with the spirit sent between Abimelech and the lords of Shechem (Judges 9:23). What the spirit does to Saul is to fill him with dread and darkness of mind, and later rage (18:10-11; 19:9-10). Whether a spirit-being is meant or a troubled state of mind sent on him, the text does not say.

decisions.choice: from Yahweh: God acts in judgment on a king he has rejected
decisions.reason: The spirit comes "from Yahweh". Saul had rejected Yahweh's word, and Yahweh had rejected him (15:23, 26). Scripture speaks the same way of God sending an evil spirit between Abimelech and Shechem (Judges 9:23) and a deceiving spirit to judge Ahab (1 Kings 22:19-23). Nothing happens outside Yahweh's rule, and he uses even harm to judge; but he remains the righteous judge, not the author of Saul's sin. The spirit later moves Saul to violence (18:10-11), yet the guilt for it stays with Saul.

decisions.choice: terrified him: seized him with sudden fear
decisions.reason: The verb means to fall on someone with terror, to frighten suddenly. It is used of terrors that overwhelm a person (2 Samuel 22:5; Job 3:5), and it returns in verse 15.

decisions.choice: tormented
decisions.reason: Balanced says "tormented" for the spirit's repeated attacks of terror (verses 15, 23); Literal keeps "terrified" and Readable "filled him with terror".

decisions.choice: sent from
decisions.reason: Readable says "sent from the LORD" to make clear that the spirit came from Yahweh and was under his rule (m3), as "God sent" in Judges 9:23.

decisions.choice: un esprit mauvais
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets: "esprit mauvais", with the adjective after the noun, a spirit that brings harm (m2); "un mauvais esprit" would mean a bad attitude in French. Lowercase "esprit", capital "Esprit" for the Spirit of the LORD.

decisions.choice: un espíritu malo
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's wording: a spirit that brings harm and distress (m2), sent by God in judgment (m3). “Maligno” would suggest a demon in the New Testament sense, which the chapter does not say. Recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "roho mbaya" (class 9 agreement: "ikamtia") against "Roho wa BWANA" (personal agreement: "akamwacha")
decisions.reason: As the terms note, "roho mbaya kutoka kwa BWANA". "Roho" takes personal agreement for the Spirit of the LORD and the class 9 agreement for the evil spirit, which keeps the two apart without a capital. "Pepo" (demon) would say more than the Hebrew does (m2).

decisions.choice: "ác thần"
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's word: a spirit that brings harm (m2); "tà linh" would suggest a demon in the New Testament sense.

decisions.choice: "주께서 보내신 악한 영" (an evil spirit the LORD sent) at Balanced and Readable; Literal "주께로부터 [온] 악한 영"
decisions.reason: The form this translation settles for 1 and 2 Samuel. "악령" would suggest a demon in the later sense; the meaning decisions (m2, m3) read it as a harmful spirit God sends in judgment.

decisions.choice: um espírito mau da parte do SENHOR (L, B); enviado pelo SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "mau", as in Judges 9:23 in Portuguese, covers both harm and wrong (m2); "maligno" would make it a demon. "Espírito" is lowercase for this spirit and capitalised for the Spirit of the LORD. "Da parte do SENHOR" says where it comes from (m3); Readable says "enviado", as the English does.

pt.B: Os oficiais de Saul lhe disseram: "O senhor está vendo que um espírito mau da parte de Deus o atormenta.
pt.R: Os oficiais de Saul disseram a ele: "Um espírito mau enviado por Deus está enchendo o senhor de terror.

decisions.choice: an evil spirit of God: an evil spirit sent by God
decisions.reason: "Of God" names where the spirit comes from: it is the spirit "from Yahweh" of verse 14. The servants use the general word for God, as people speaking in ordinary life often do.

decisions.choice: look now: a polite opening
decisions.reason: The servants point to what everyone can see before making their suggestion (verse 16). Their words run on into the next verse.

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable call Saul's servants "officials", as with the king's servants elsewhere in these books; Literal keeps "servants".

decisions.choice: from God
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "from God" for "of God" (m1).

decisions.choice: les serviteurs de Saül (L); les officiers de Saül (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for the king's servants: "serviteurs" at Literal, "officiers" at Balanced and Readable, as the English "officials" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: los siervos de Saúl (L); los oficiales de Saúl (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for the king's servants: “siervos” at Literal, “oficiales” at Balanced and Readable, as the English “officials” (r-en-1). Recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "watumishi wa Sauli" (L); "maafisa wa Sauli" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For this block, as the terms note: the king's servants are "watumishi" at Literal and "maafisa" (officials) at Balanced and Readable, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "các đầy tớ của Sau-lơ" (L), "các quần thần" (B, R); subjects call the king "vua" (L), "bệ hạ" (B), "đức vua" (R) and "thưa" with him
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for the king's servants and for address to the king; this holds through the block.

decisions.choice: "사울의 신하들" for Saul's servants at every level; they speak to him in the formal polite style (합쇼체), calling him "임금님" and themselves "임금님의 종들"
decisions.reason: "신하들" covers both "servants" and "officials" of a king, as the terms of this translation set for "the king's servants"; subjects address the king in 합쇼체 throughout the book.

decisions.choice: o senhor (the officials to Saul)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Saul's servants and subjects speak to the king with "o senhor" and call themselves "os seus servos" (verse 16), the respectful address to a superior; the king says "você" and "vocês" to them.
